directive.quote: Reuse original exact held selector if already sufficient; avoid redundant5copies unless needed by contract baseline checks. Do not export/import inert artifacts or alter guard. Continue generic adaptation/proofs after source baseline admitted.

preserve: Use the shared whole-label host rule, never a host-text suffix check.
The longest matching host suffix wins for one address.
The first shared address with a site action determines the selected saved action.
An action is returned only from the current account's supplied actions.
Keep the browser-pure actionForAddress, siteAction, startingAction and routingAction exports.
allowed_deltas: Resolve hostWithin from its current public Workshop owner without importing a server runtime.
banned_substitutions: A bundled list of account actions or site defaults

baseline.why: The baseline bytes at this commit (3e94a853e, the commit before a3a988c8 removed the held copy) differ from ae875b9b0's copy on the claude/* branch only by one import path, rewritten by the rename a6b9518c1; the original is on the claude/* branch.
